G4367.def:
**προσ-τάσσω **
[in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;]
1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to.
2. **to give a command, enjoin, appoint**: [[Luk.5.14|Luk.5:14]] with dative of person(s), [[Mat.1.24|Mat.1:24]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.8.4|Mat.8:4]], [[Mrk.1.44|Mrk.1:44]]; with accusative and inf., [[Act.10.48|Act.10:48]] pass., [[Act.10.33; 17.26|Act.10:33 17:26]].†
(AS)

G4374.def:
**προσ-φέρω **
[in LXX chiefly for קָרַב hi. ;]
1. **to bring to, lead to**: with accusative and dative of person(s), [[Mat.4.24; 8.16; 9.2, 32; 14.35; 17.16|Mat.4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16]], [[Mrk.2.4|Mrk.2:4]] (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) [[Mrk.10.13|Mrk.10:13]], [[Luk.18.15; 23.14|Luk.18:15 23:14]]; pass., [[Mat.12.22|Mat.12:22]] (act., WH, txt.) [[Mat.18.24|Mat.18:24]] (προσήχθη, WH) [[Mat.19.13|Mat.19:13]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.25.20|Mat.25:20]] id. with dative of person(s), [[Mat.22.19|Mat.22:19]], [[Luk.23.36|Luk.23:36]]; τ. στόματι, [[Jhn.19.29|Jhn.19:29]] metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with, [[Heb.12.7|Heb.12:7]] (cl.).
2. **to offer**: [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]], [[Act.8.18|Act.8:18]]; esp. (as frequently in LXX; cf. FlJ, _Ant._, iii, 9, 3) sacrifices, **gifts and prayers to God**: absol., before περί (ὑπέρ), [[Mrk.1.44|Mrk.1:44]], [[Luk.5.14|Luk.5:14]], [[Heb.5.1, 3; 9.7; 10.12|Heb.5:1, 3 9:7 10:12]]; pass., [[Act.21.26|Act.21:26]] with accusative of thing(s) (δῶρον, θυσίαν, λυτρείαν, προσφοράν), [[Mat.5.23-24|Mat.5:23-24]] (aoristic pres.; M, _Pr._, 247) [[Mat.8.4|Mat.8:4]], [[Jhn.16.2|Jhn.16:2]], [[Act.7.42; 21.26|Act.7:42 21:26]], [[Heb.5.1; 8.3-4; 9.7, 9; 10.1-2, 8; 10.11-12|Heb.5:1 8:3-4 9:7, 9 10:1-2, 8 10:11-12]]; δεήσεις τε κ. ἱκετηρίας, [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]] with accusative of person(s), [[Heb.11.17|Heb.11:17]] (conative impf.; M, _Pr._, 129); of Christ, [[Heb.7.27|Heb.7:27]] (ἀνενέγκας, WH, txt.) [[Heb.9.14, 25; 9.28|Heb.9:14, 25 9:28]].†
(AS)

G4334.def:
**προσ-έρχομαι **
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;]
**to approach, draw near**: absol., [[Mat.4.11|Mat.4:11]], [[Luk.9.42|Luk.9:42]], al.; with infin., [[Mat.24.1|Mat.24:1]], al.; with dative loc., [[Heb.12.18, 22|Heb.12:18, 22]]; dative of person(s), [[Mat.5.1|Mat.5:1]], and freq., [[Jhn.12.21|Jhn.12:21]], al.; ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., [[Mat.8.2|Mat.8:2]], and freq., [[Mrk.1.31|Mrk.1:31]], [[Luk.7.14|Luk.7:14]], al.; π. αὐτῷ, with indic., [[Mat.4.3|Mat.4:3]], [[Mrk.6.35|Mrk.6:35]],
Metaphorical,
(a) **of approaching God**: absol. ([[Lev.21.17|Lev.21:17]], [[Deu.21.5|Deu.21:5]], al.), [[Heb.10.1, 22|Heb.10:1, 22]]; τ. θεῷ, [[Heb.7.25; 11.6|Heb.7:25 11:6]]; τ. θρόνῳ τ. χάριτος, [[Heb.4.16|Heb.4:16]] πρὸς Χριστόν, [[1Pe.2.4|1Pe.2:4]]
(b) in sense not found elsewhere (Field, _Notes_, 211), **to consent to**: ὑγιαίνουσι λόγοις, [[1Ti.6.3|1Ti.6:3]]
(AS)

G4350.def:
**προσ-κόπτω **
[in LXX for נָגַף, כָּשַׁל ni., etc. ;]
1. trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, [[Mat.4.6|Mat.4:6]], [[Luk.4.11|Luk.4:11]], (LXX)
2. Intrans., **to stumble**: absol. ([[Tob.11.9|Tob.11:9]], [[Pro.3.23|Pro.3:23]]), [[Jhn.11.9-10|Jhn.11:9-10]]; of wind, **to rush against, beat upon**: with dative, [[Mat.7.27|Mat.7:27]] Metaphorical, in late writers,
(a) **to offend **(Polyb.);
(b) **to take offence at, stumble at**: before ἐν, [[Rom.14.21|Rom.14:21]] with dative, τ. λόγῳ, [[1Pe.2.8|1Pe.2:8]] τ. λίθῳ τ. προσκόμματος, [[Rom.9.32|Rom.9:32]]†
(AS)

G4337.def:
**προσ-έχω **
[in LXX for קָשַׁב hi., שָׁמַר ni., etc. ;]
1. to turn to, bring to (frequently ναῦν, expressed or understood, to bring to port, land; Hdt., al.).
2. τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted (El., § 53, 1; 81, 1): [[Act.8.6; 16.14|Act.8:6 16:14]], [[Heb.2.1|Heb.2:1]], [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]]; in sense of caring or providing for, [[Act.20.28|Act.20:28]] π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself (M, _Pr._, 157; cf. [[Gen.24.6|Gen.24:6]], [[Exo.10.28|Exo.10:28]], al.): [[Luk.17.3; 21.34|Luk.17:3 21:34]], [[Act.5.35|Act.5:35]]; id. before ἀπό (M, _Pr._, 102; B1., § 34, 11; 40, 3; see: βλέπω), [[Luk.12.1|Luk.12:1]] (without dative) [[Mat.7.15; 10.17; 16.6, 11-12|Mat.7:15 10:17 16:6, 11-12]], [[Luk.20.46|Luk.20:46]] (cf. [[Sir.6.13|Sir.6:13]], al.); before μή, with inf. (M, _Pr._, 193; Bl., § 69, 4), [[Mat.6.1|Mat.6:1]]
3. **to attach or devote oneself to**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.8.10-11|Act.8:10-11]], [[1Ti.4.1|1Ti.4:1]]; with dative of thing(s), [[1Ti.1.4; 3.8; 4.13; 6.3|1Ti.1:4 3:8 4:13 6:3]] T (-ερχ-, WH, R), [[Tit.1.14|Tit.1:14]], [[Heb.7.13|Heb.7:13]].†
(AS)

G4383.def:
**πρόσωπον**, -ου, τό
(πρός, ὤψ), [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for פָּנִים ;]
1. prop., of persons (so always in cl.);
(a) **the face, countenance**: [[Mat.6.16-17|Mat.6:16-17]], [[Mrk.14.65|Mrk.14:65]], [[Luk.9.29|Luk.9:29]], [[2Co.3.7|2Co.3:7]], [[Rev.4.7|Rev.4:7]], al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), [[Jas.1.23|Jas.1:23]] πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., [[Mat.17.6|Mat.17:6]], [[Luk.5.12|Luk.5:12]], [[Rev.7.11|Rev.7:11]], al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., [[Gal.1.22|Gal.1:22]] π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, [[1Th.2.17|1Th.2:17]] κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, **facing**: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, [[Act.25.16|Act.25:16]], [[2Co.10.1; 10.7|2Co.10:1 10:7]], [[Gal.2.11|Gal.2:11]]; id. with genitive, as compound prep., in the presence of (not cl.; see Bl., § 40, 9; M, _Pr._, 99 f.; Thackeray, _Gr._, 43 f.), [[Luk.2.31|Luk.2:31]], [[Act.3.13|Act.3:13]]; similarly ἀπὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים מִלִּפְּנֵי); see Dalman, _Words_, 29), from the presence of, [[Act.3.19; 5.41; 7.45|Act.3:19 5:41 7:45]], [[2Th.1.9|2Th.1:9]], [[Rev.12.14; 20.11|Rev.12:14 20:11]]; πρὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים לִפְנֵי), before, [[Mat.11.10|Mat.11:10]], [[Mrk.1.2|Mrk.1:2]], [[Luk.7.27|Luk.7:27]]" (LXX), al.; in other phrases resembling _Heb._ idiom (Thackeray, _Gr._, 42), βλέπειν (ὁρᾶν, θεωρεῖν, ἰδεῖν) τὸ π., to see one's face, i.e. see him in person, [[Mat.18.10|Mat.18:10]], [[Act.20.25, 38|Act.20:25, 38]], [[1Th.3.10|1Th.3:10]], [[Rev.22.4|Rev.22:4]]; ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[Heb.9.24|Heb.9:24]] ἐν π. Χριστοῦ, [[2Co.2.10; 4.6|2Co.2:10 4:6]]; μετὰ τοῦ π. σου with thy presence, [[Act.2.28|Act.2:28]] (LXX); εἰς π. τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν, [[2Co.8.24|2Co.8:24]] στηρίζειν τὸ π. (Heb. פָּנִים שׂוּם: [[Jer.21.10|Jer.21:10]], al.; see Dalman, _Words_, 30), with inf., to set one's face towards, [[Luk.9.51|Luk.9:51]] similarly, τὸ π. αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον (_op. cit._, 31), [[Luk.9.53|Luk.9:53]] τὸ π. τοῦ κυρίου ἐπί, [[1Pe.3.12|1Pe.3:12]] (LXX)
(b) **form, person**: καυχᾶσθαι. ἐν π. καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ, [[2Co.5.12|2Co.5:12]] (cf. [[1Sa.16.7|1Ki.16:7]]); metaphorically, as in _Heb._ idiom, of judgment according to appearance, **external condition or circumstances **(פָּנִים H5387; see Dalman, _Words_, 30; Thackeray, _Gr._, 43 f.): λαμβάνειν π., [[Luk.20.21|Luk.20:21]], [[Gal.2.6|Gal.2:6]]; βλέπειν εἰς π., [[Mat.22.16|Mat.22:16]], [[Mrk.12.14|Mrk.12:14]]; θαυμάζειν πρόσωπα, [[Jude.16|Ju 16]].
2. Of things (cf. Dalman, l.with)
(a) face, appearance ([[Psa.104.30|Psa.104:30]]): [[Mat.16.3|Mat.16:3]] (WH, R, mg., om.), [[Luk.12.56|Luk.12:56]], [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]]
(b) surface ([[Gen.2.6|Gen.2:6]]): [[Luk.21.35|Luk.21:35]], [[Act.17.26|Act.17:26]]
(AS)

G4369.def:
**προσ-τίθημι **
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc. ;]
1. to put to.
2. **to add, join to, give in addition**: with accusative before ἐπί, [[Mat.6.27|Mat.6:27]], [[Luk.3.20; 12.25|Luk.3:20 12:25]]; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, [[Act.2.47|Act.2:47]] with accusative and dative, [[Luk.17.5|Luk.17:5]], [[Heb.12.19|Heb.12:19]] (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., [[Act.2.41|Act.2:41]], [[Gal.3.19|Gal.3:19]]; with dative, [[Mat.6.33|Mat.6:33]], [[Mrk.4.24|Mrk.4:24]], [[Luk.12.31|Luk.12:31]], [[Act.5.14; 11.24|Act.5:14 11:24]]; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. [[Gen.26.8|Gen.26:8]], [[Jdg.2.10|Jdg.2:10]], al.), [[Act.13.36|Act.13:36]]; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action signified by the following verb, as in _Heb._ idiom ([[Gen.4.2; 8.12|Gen.4:2 8:12]], al.; cf. WM, § 54, 5; Lft. on Clem., 1Co., xii; but see also M, _Pr._, 67, 233; Deiss., BS, 67.1; MM, xxi), [[Luk.20.11|Luk.20:11]], [[Act.12.3|Act.12:3]]; similarly ptcp., προσ-θείς, with indic. ([[Gen.38.5|Gen.38:5]], al.), [[Luk.19.11|Luk.19:11]].†
(AS)

G4395.def:
**προφητεύω**
(προφήτης), [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;]
to be a προφήτης (which see), **to prophesy**: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, [[Mat.7.22; 26.68|Mat.7:22 26:68]], [[Mrk.14.65|Mrk.14:65]], [[Luk.1.67; 22.64|Luk.1:67 22:64]], [[Act.19.6|Act.19:6]], [[1Co.11.4-5; 13.9; 14.1; 14.3-5; 14.24; 14.31; 14.39|1Co.11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39]], [[Heb.11.3|Heb.11:3]]; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., _Notes_, 83 f.), [[Mat.11.13|Mat.11:13]], [[Act.2.17-18|Act.2:17-18]]" (LXX) [[Act.21.9|Act.21:9]] before περί, [[Mat.15.7|Mat.15:7]], [[Mrk.7.6|Mrk.7:6]], [[1Pe.1.10|1Pe.1:10]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[Rev.10.11|Rev.10:11]] λέγων, [[Jude.14|Ju 14]]; ὅτι, [[Jhn.11.51|Jhn.11:51]]†
_SYN._: μαντεύομαι, q.v (AS)

G4363.def:
**προσ-πίπτω**
[in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;]
1. **to fall upon, strike against**: with dative, of wind, [[Mat.7.25|Mat.7:25]]
2. **to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before**: absol., before πρός, [[Mrk.7.25|Mrk.7:25]] with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.3.11; 5.33|Mrk.3:11 5:33]], [[Luk.8.28|Luk.8:28]], [[Act.16.29|Act.16:29]]; τ. γόνασιν, [[Luk.5.8|Luk.5:8]]†
(AS)

G4341.def:
**προσ-καλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to call to. Mid., **to call to oneself **(see M, _Pr._, 157): with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.10.1|Mat.10:1]], [[Mrk.3.13; 6.7|Mrk.3:13 6:7]], [[Luk.7.19|Luk.7:19]], [[Act.5.40|Act.5:40]], [[Jas.5.14|Jas.5:14]], al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: [[Act.2.39|Act.2:39]] with inf., [[Act.16.10|Act.16:10]] (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, [[Act.13.2|Act.13:2]]†
(AS)

G4328.def:
**προσ-δοκάω**, -ῶ
(the simple verb exists only in the forms δοκέω, -εύω) [in LXX: [[Psa.104.27|Psa.104:27]] (שָׂבַר pi.), etc. ;]
**to await, expect**: [[Mat.24.50|Mat.24:50]], [[Luk.3.15; 12.46|Luk.3:15 12:46]], [[Act.27.33; 28.6|Act.27:33 28:6]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.11.3|Mat.11:3]], [[Luk.1.21; 7.19-20; 8.40|Luk.1:21 7:19-20 8:40]] [[Act.10.24|Act.10:24]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[2Pe.3.12-14;|2Pe.3:12-14]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]] with inf., [[Act.3.5|Act.3:5]]†
(AS)

G4377.def:
**προσ-φωνέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[1Es.2.21|1Es.2:21]] [[Est.6.6|Est.6:6]] [[Est.6.22|Est.6:22]], [[2Ma.15.15|2Ma.15:15]] * ;]
1. **to address, call to**; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): [[Act.21.40|Act.21:40]] In late writers, with dative of person(s): [[Mat.11.16|Mat.11:16]], [[Luk.7.32; 13.12; 23.20|Luk.7:32 13:12 23:20]], [[Act.22.2|Act.22:2]].
2. **to call by name, summon**: with accusative (as in cl.), [[Luk.6.13|Luk.6:13]]†
(AS)

G4394.def:
**προφητεία**, -ας, ἡ
(προψητεύω) [in LXX for נְבוּאָה, חָזוֹן ;]
the gift (and its exercise) of interpreting the Divine will and purpose, **prophecy, prophesying**: of OT prophecy, [[Mat.13.14|Mat.13:14]], [[2Pe.1.20-21|2Pe.1:20-21]]; of NT prophecy, [[Rom.12.6|Rom.12:6]], [[1Co.12.10; 13.2; 14.6; 14.22|1Co.12:10 13:2 14:6 14:22]], [[1Ti.4.14|1Ti.4:14]], [[Rev.11.6; 22.19|Rev.11:6 22:19]]; pl., [[1Co.13.8|1Co.13:8]], [[1Th.5.20|1Th.5:20]], [[1Ti.1.18|1Ti.1:18]]; οἱ λόγοι τῆς π., [[Rev.1.3; 22.7, 10; 22.18|Rev.1:3 22:7, 10 22:18]]; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς π., [[Rev.19.10|Rev.19:10]] (Luc., FlJ, LXX, π.; see Deiss., BS, 235 f.; MM, xxii).†
(AS)

G4340.def:
**πρόσ-καιρος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[4Ma.15.2|4Ma.15:2]] [[4Mac.15.8|4Mac 15:8]] [[4Mac.15.23|4Mac 15:23]] * ;]
1. in season.
2. **for a season, temporary, transient**: [[2Co.4.18|2Co.4:18]], [[Heb.11.25|Heb.11:25]]; of plants, **short-lived**: [[Mat.13.21|Mat.13:21]], [[Mrk.4.17|Mrk.4:17]].†
(AS)

G4357.def:
**προσ-μένω **
[in LXX: [[Jdg.3.25|Jdg.3:25]] A (חוּל hi.), [[Tob.2.2|Tob.2:2]] א, [[Wis.3.9|Wis.3:9]], [[3Ma.7.17|3Ma.7:17]] * ;]
1. **to wait longer, continue, remain still**: [[Act.18.18|Act.18:18]] before ἐν, [[1Ti.1.3|1Ti.1:3]]
2. C. dative, **to remain with**: [[Mat.15.32|Mat.15:32]], [[Mrk.8.32|Mrk.8:32]]. Metaphorical, **to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in**: τ. κυρίῳ, [[Act.11.23|Act.11:23]] (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, [[Act.13.43|Act.13:43]] τ. δεήσεσιν, [[1Ti.5.5|1Ti.5:5]]†
(AS)

G4355.def:
**προσ-λαμβάνω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.18.16|Psa.18:16]] (מָשָׁה hi.), [[Psa.73.24|Psa.73:24]] (לָקַח), etc. ;]
1. to take in addition.
2. **to take to oneself, take, receive**; in NT always mid., -ομαι;
(a) **of things**: of food, with accusative, [[Act.27.33|Act.27:33]] with genitive part., [[Act.27.36|Act.27:36]]
(b) **of persons**: with accusative, [[Mat.16.22|Mat.16:22]], [[Mrk.8.32|Mrk.8:32]] (see Swete, in l), [[Act.17.5; 18.26; 28.2|Act.17:5 18:26 28:2]], [[Rom.14.1, 3; 15.7|Rom.14:1, 3 15:7]], Phm 17.†
(AS)

G4399.def:
**προ-φθάνω **
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַם pi. ;]
with ptcp. (as in cl., but more frequently the simple φθάνω, which see),
**to anticipate**: [[Mat.17.25|Mat.17:25]]†
(AS)

G4335.def:
**προσ-ευχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσεύχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּפִלָּה ;]
1. **prayer to God**: [[Mat.17.21|Mat.17:21]] (WH, R, txt., om.) [[Mat.21.22|Mat.21:22]], [[Mrk.9.29|Mrk.9:29]], [[Luk.22.45|Luk.22:45]], [[Act.3.1; 6.4; 10.31|Act.3:1 6:4 10:31]], [[Rom.12.12|Rom.12:12]], [[1Co.7.5|1Co.7:5]], [[Col.4.2|Col.4:2]]; pl., [[Act.2.42; 10.4|Act.2:42 10:4]], [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]], [[Eph.1.16|Eph.1:16]] [[Col.4.12|Col.4:12]], [[1Th.1.2|1Th.1:2]], Phm 4 22, [[1Pe.3.7; 4.7|1Pe.3:7 4:7]], [[Rev.5.8; 8.3-4|Rev.5:8 8:3-4]]; οἶκος προσευχῆς, [[Mat.21.13|Mat.21:13]], [[Mrk.11.17|Mrk.11:17]], [[Luk.19.46|Luk.19:46]]" (LXX) ; π. καὶ δέησις, [[Eph.6.18|Eph.6:18]], [[Php.4.6|Php.4:6]]; pl., [[1Ti.2.1; 5.5|1Ti.2:1 5:5]]; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, prayer to God (ef. [[Wis.16.28|Wis.16:28]]), [[Luk.6.12|Luk.6:12]]; πρὸς τ. θεόν, before ὑπέρ, [[Act.12.5|Act.12:5]] pl., [[Rom.15.30|Rom.15:30]] Hebraistically (B1., § 38, 3), προσευχῇ προσεύχεσθαι, [[Jas.5.17|Jas.5:17]] (EV, prayed fervently).
2. **a place of prayer**: of a synagogue ([[3Ma.7.20|3Ma.7:20]], seel.; see Charles, APOT, i, 173; for other exx., see Kennedy, _Sources_, 114); of a place in the open (FlJ, _Ant._, xiv, 10, 23), [[Act.16.13, 16|Act.16:13, 16]].†
_SYN._: see: δέησις (AS)

G4339.def:
**προσήλυτος**, -ον
(προοελαύνω), [in LXX for גֵּר ;]
1. one who has arrived, a stranger.
2. **Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte **(see _DB_, see word): [[Mat.23.15|Mat.23:15]], [[Act.2.10; 6.5; 13.43|Act.2:10 6:5 13:43]].†
(AS)

G4351.def:
**προσ-κυλίω **
**to roll up, roll to**: with accusative and dative, [[Mat.27.60|Mat.27:60]] accusative before ἐπί, [[Mrk.15.46|Mrk.15:46]]†
(AS)

G4342.def:
**προσ-καρτερέω**, -ῶ
(καρτερός, strong, stedfast) [in LXX: [[Num.13.21|Num.13:21]] (חָזַק hith.), [[Tob.5.8|Tob.5:8]] א, Da Th [[Sus.1.6|Su 1:6]]* ;]
**to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on**: with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.3.9|Mrk.3:9]], [[Act.8.13; 10.7|Act.8:13 10:7]]; with dative of thing(s), [[Act.1.14; 2.42; 6.4|Act.1:14 2:42 6:4]], [[Rom.12.12|Rom.12:12]], [[Col.4.2|Col.4:2]]; before ἐν, [[Act.2.46|Act.2:46]] εἰς, [[Rom.13.6|Rom.13:6]]†
(AS)

G4358.def:
**προσ-ορμίζω**
(ὅρμος, an anchorage),
**to bring a ship to anchor at**; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): [[Mrk.6.53|Mrk.6:53]]†
(AS)

G4347.def:
**προσ-κολλάω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;]
**to glue to**; pass., **reflexive, to stick to, cleave to **(Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, [[Jos.23.8|Jos.23:8]], [[Sir.6.34|Sir.6:34]] al.), before πρός, [[Mrk.10.7|Mrk.10:7]] (R, txt.), [[Eph.5.31|Eph.5:31]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4365.def:
**προσ-πορεύομαι **
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;]
**to come near, approach**: with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.10.35|Mrk.10:35]]†
(AS)

G4301.def:
**προ-λαμβάνω **
[in LXX: [[Wis.17.11|Wis.17:11]] א2, [[Wis.17.17|Wis.17:17]] א2B * ;]
1. **to take beforehand**: with accusative, [[1Co.11.21|1Co.11:21]] (but see infr.).
2. to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), [[Mrk.14.8|Mrk.14:8]]
3. **to overtake, surprise**: pass., [[Gal.6.1|Gal.6:1]] (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and perhaps also in 1Co, l.with, see MM, xxi).†
(AS)

G4327.def:
**προσ-δέχομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for רָצָה ;]
1. **to receive to oneself, receive favourably, admit, accept**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.15.2|Luk.15:2]], [[Rom.16.2|Rom.16:2]], [[Php.2.29|Php.2:29]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.24.15|Act.24:15]] (R, mg.), [[Heb.10.34; 11.35|Heb.10:34 11:35]].
2. **to expect, look for, wait for**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.12.36|Luk.12:36]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.15.43|Mrk.15:43]], [[Luk.2.25, 38; 23.51|Luk.2:25, 38 23:51]], [[Act.23.21|Act.23:21]], [[Tit.2.13|Tit.2:13]], [[Jude.21|Ju 21]] (cf. δέχομαι).†
(AS)

G4313.def:
**προ-πορεύω **
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ, also for עָבַר, etc. ;]
to make to go before. Pass. and mid., **to go before**: [[Luk.1.76|Luk.1:76]], [[Act.7.40|Act.7:40]]" (LXX) ,†
(AS)

G4393.def:
**προφέρω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.10.13|Pro.10:13]] (מָצָא ni.), [[Tob.9.5|Tob.9:5]], al. ;]
**to bring forth**: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐκ, [[Luk.6.45|Luk.6:45]]†
(AS)

G4317.def:
**προσ-άγω **
[in LXX chiefly for = קָרַב hi., also for נָגַשׁ etc. ;]
1. trans., **to bring or lead**: with accusative and dative, [[Act.16.20|Act.16:20]] metaphorically, τ. θεῷ, [[1Pe.3.18|1Pe.3:18]] before ὧδε, [[Luk.9.41|Luk.9:41]] pass., with dative, [[Mat.18.24|Mat.18:24]] (προσηνέχθη, T); in forensic sense, **to summon**: [[Act.12.6|Act.12:6]] (προαγαγεῖν, T, WH, mg., R).
2. Intrans., to draw near, approach ([[Jos.3.9|Jos.3:9]], [[Jer.26.3|Jer.26:3]] ([[Jer.46.3|Jer.46:3]]), al.): with dative, [[Act.27.27|Act.27:27]] (WH, προσαχεῖν).†
(AS)

G4379.def:
**προσ-ψαύω **
in poët. and late writers,
**to touch**: with dative, [[Luk.11.46|Luk.11:46]]†
(AS)

G4320.def:
**προσ-ανα-βαίνω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.19.23|Exo.19:23]], al. (עָלָה) ;]
1. to go up besides.
2. **to go up higher**: [[Luk.14.10|Luk.14:10]]†
(AS)

G4390.def:
**προ-τρέχω **
[in LXX: [[1Sa.8.11|1Ki.8:11]] (פָּנִים רוּץ), [[Job.41.13|Job.41:13]] (14) A (דּוּץ), [[Tob.11.3|Tob.11:3]] (before ἔμπροσθεν), [[1Ma.16.21|1Ma.16:21]] * ;]
1. to run forward.
2. **to run on, run in advance**: [[Jhn.20.4|Jhn.20:4]] before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, [[Luk.19.4|Luk.19:4]]†
(AS)

G4333.def:
**προσ-εργάζομαι **
1. to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.).
2. **to gain besides, by working or trading**: [[Luk.19.16|Luk.19:16]] (Xen.).†
(AS)

G4329.def:
**προσδοκία**, -ας, ἡ
(ιροσδοκάω), [in LXX: [[Gen.49.10|Gen.49:10]] (יִקָּהָה), [[Psa.119.116|Psa.119:116]] (שֵׂבֶר) [[Wis.17.13|Wis.17:13]], [[Sir.40.2|Sir.40:2]], al. ;]
**expectation**: with genitive obj., [[Luk.21.26|Luk.21:26]] with genitive subjc., [[Act.12.11|Act.12:11]]†
(AS)

G4391.def:
**προ-ϋπ-άρχω **
[in LXX: [[Job.42.18|Job 42:18]]* ;]
1. to be beforehand in.
2. **to be before or previously**: with ptcp., [[Luk.23.12|Luk.23:12]], [[Act.8.9|Act.8:9]].†
(AS)

G4364.def:
**προσ-ποιέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[1Sa.21.13|1Ki.21:13]] (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), [[Job.19.14|Job.19:14]], ([[Sir.34.30|Sir 34:30]] ([[Sir.31.30|Sir.31:30]])), Dan LXX [[Sus.1.11|Su 1:11]] * ;]
to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), **to make as if**: [[Luk.24.28|Luk.24:28]]†
(AS)

G4387.def:
A. _Compar._, **πρότερος**, -α, -ον,
[in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;]
**before**, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, **before, former**: [[Eph.4.22|Eph.4:22]] Adverbially, πρότερον, **before, aforetime, formerly**: [[Jhn.7.50|Jhn.7:50]], [[2Co.1.15|2Co.1:15]], [[Heb.4.6|Heb.4:6]]; opposite to ἔπειτα, [[Heb.7.27|Heb.7:27]] τὸ π., [[Jhn.6.62; 9.8|Jhn.6:62 9:8]], [[Gal.4.13|Gal.4:13]], [[1Ti.1.13|1Ti.1:13]]; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, [[Heb.10.32|Heb.10:32]] αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, [[1Pe.1.14|1Pe.1:14]]†
(AS)

G4319.def:
**προσ-αιτέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Job.27.14|Job.27:14]] * ;]
1. to ask besides.
2. **to continue asking; hence, to importune, beg, ask alms**: [[Jhn.9.8|Jhn.9:8]]†
(AS)

G4371.def:
**προσφάγιον**, -ου, τό
(φαγεῖν),
Hellenistic for ὄψον ὀψάριον)
a relish or dainty (esp, cooked fish), **to be eaten with bread**: [[Jhn.21.5|Jhn.21:5]] (have ye taken any fish, Field, _Notes_, 109; Abbott, _Essays_, 105; cf. M, _Pr._, 170n; MM, _Exp._, xxi).†
(AS)

G4302.def:
**προ-λέγω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.41.26|Isa.41:26]] (נָגַד hi.) * ;]
1. **to tell or say before­hand**: [[2Co.13.2|2Co.13:2]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]], [[1Th.3.4|1Th.3:4]] (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.).
2. **to declare, tell plainly**: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).†
(AS)

G4308.def:
**προ-οράω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Psa.16.8|Psa.16:8]]) (שָׁוָה pi.), I [[Est.5.63|Est.5:63]] A * ;]
**to see before **(as to place or time): with accusative, [[Act.21.29|Act.21:29]] Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, [[Act.2.25|Act.2:25]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4309.def:
**προ-ορίζω **
**to predetermine, foreordain**: with accusative, [[Rom.8.30|Rom.8:30]] id. and inf., [[Act.4.28|Act.4:28]] id. before εἰς, [[1Co.2.7|1Co.2:7]], [[Eph.1.5|Eph.1:5]]; with dupl. accusative, [[Rom.8.26|Rom.8:26]] pass., [[Eph.1.11|Eph.1:11]]†
(AS)

G4381.def:
**προσωπο-λήμπτης** (Rec. -λήπτης, see Bl., § 6, 8), -ου, ὁ
(πρόσωπον λαμβάνειν, see: πρόσωπον),
**a respecter of persons**: [[Act.10.34|Act.10:34]] (on this group of cognate forms, see Mayor, da., 78 f.; and cf. Thackeray, _Gr._, 44).†
(AS)

G4354.def:
**προσ-λαλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Exo.4.16|Exo.4:16]] AB2 (דָבַר pi.), [[Wis.13.17|Wis.13:17]] * ;]
**to speak to**: [[Act.28.20|Act.28:20]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.13.43|Act.13:43]]†
(AS)

G4311.def:
**προ-πέμπω **
[in LXX: I [[Est.4.47|Est.4:47]], [[Jdt.10.15|Jdth.10:15]], [[Wis.19.2|Wis.19:2]], [[1Ma.12.4|1Ma.12:4]], [[2Ma.6.23|2Ma.6:23]] * ;]
1. to send before, send forth.
2. **to set forward on a journey, escort**: with accusative of person(s), [[1Co.16.11|1Co.16:11]], [[Tit.3.13|Tit.3:13]], [[3Jn.6|3Jn.6]]; before εἰς, [[Act.20.38|Act.20:38]] οὗ, [[1Co.16.6|1Co.16:6]] ἕως, [[Act.21.5|Act.21:5]] pass., [[Act.15.3|Act.15:3]], [[Rom.15.24|Rom.15:24]], [[2Co.1.16|2Co.1:16]].†
(AS)

G4345.def:
**προσ-κληρόω**, -ῶ
**to allot to, assign to by lot**; pass. (but perh. as nid., EV, consorted with, so Syr.): [[Act.17.4|Act.17:4]] (for exx., v, Cremer, 749).†
(AS)

G4326.def:
**προσ-δέομαι **
[in LXX: [[Pro.12.9|Pro.12:9]] חָסֵר חָסֵר [[Sir.6.1-37|Sir.6:1-37]] * ;]
**to want further, need in addition**: [[Act.17.25|Act.17:25]]†
(AS)

G4389.def:
**προ-τρέπω **
[in LXX: [[Wis.14.18|Wis.14:18]], [[2Ma.11.7|2Ma.11:7]], [[4Ma.12.7|4Ma.12:7]] [[4Mac.15.12|4Mac 15:12]] [[4Mac.16.13|4Mac 16:13]] * ;]
to urge forwards, exhort, persuade. Mid., in same sense (as also in cl.): [[Act.18.27|Act.18:27]]†
(AS)

G4312.def:
**προπετής**, -ές
(προπίπτω), [in LXX: [[Pro.10.14|Pro.10:14]] (אֱוִיל) [[Pro.13.3|Pro.13:3]] (פָּשַׂק) [[Sir.9.18|Sir.9:18]] * ;]
falling forwards, headlong. Metaphorical, **precipitate, rash, reck­less**: of persons, [[2Ti.3.4|2Ti.3:4]] of things, [[Act.19.36|Act.19:36]]†
(AS)

G4376.def:
**προσ-φορά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(προσφέρω), [in LXX: [[1Ki.7.48|3Ki.7:48]] (פָּנִים) [[Psa.40.6|Psa.40:6]] (מִנְחָה), I [[Est.5.52|Est.5:52]], [[Sir.14.11|Sir.14:11]], al. ;]
1. a bringing to, offering (Plat., al.).
2. (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: [[Act.21.26; 24.17|Act.21:26 24:17]], [[Eph.5.2|Eph.5:2]], [[Heb.10.5, 8; 10.14|Heb.10:5, 8 10:14]]; περί ἀμαρτίας, [[Heb.10.18|Heb.10:18]] with genitive obj., [[Rom.15.16|Rom.15:16]], [[Heb.10.10|Heb.10:10]].†
(AS)

G4385.def:
**προ-τείνω**, [in LXX: 2Ma_7:1-42, 3Ma_2:1 * ;]
**to stretch out, stretch forth**: of preparations for scourging (see Field, _Notes_, 136 f.), [[Act.22.25|Act.22:25]]†
(AS)

G4307.def:
**πρόνοια**, -ας, ἡ
(πρόνοος, careful) [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:18 (19) [[Wis.14.3; 17.2|Wis.14:3 17:2]], [[4Ma.6.1-35|4Mac.6:1-35]] * ;]
**foresight, forethought**: [[Act.24.3|Act.24:3]] π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), **make provision for, show care for**: [[Rom.13.14|Rom.13:14]]†
(AS)

G4330.def: **to suffer to go further **, τινά (New Testament) (ML)

G4388.def:
**προ-τίθημι **
[in LXX: [[Exo.40.4, 23|Exo.40:4, 23]], [[Lev.24.8|Lev.24:8]] (עָרַךְ) [[Psa.54.3|Psa.54:3]] (שׂוּם), etc. ;]
1. **to set before, set forth publicly**; so also in mid.: with accusative of person(s), [[Rom.3.25|Rom.3:25]] (for a suggested alt, rend., see MM, xxii).
2. Mid., **to set before oneself, propose, purpose**: with inf., [[Rom.1.13|Rom.1:13]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Eph.1.9|Eph.1:9]]†
(AS)

G4382.def:
**προσωπολημψία** (Rec. -ληψία), -ας, ἡ
(προσωπολήμπτης)
**respect of persons**: [[Rom.2.11|Rom.2:11]], [[Eph.6.9|Eph.6:9]], [[Col.3.25|Col.3:25]], [[Jas.2.1|Jas.2:1]] (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G4318.def:
**προσ-αγωγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσάγω),
1. a bringing to.
2. **approach, access **(see Lft., _Notes_, 284; MM, xxi): [[Rom.5.2|Rom.5:2]], [[Eph.2.18; 3.12|Eph.2:18 3:12]] (but see Ellic., _Eph._, 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).†
(AS)

G4348.def:
**πρόσ-κομμα**, -τος, τό
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: [[Exo.23.33; 34.12|Exo.23:33 34:12]] (מוֹקֵשׁ), [[Isa.8.14|Isa.8:14]] (נֶגֶף), [[Jdt.8.22|Jdth.8:22]], [[Sir.17.25|Sir.17:25]], al. ;]
(a) **a stumble, stumbling**: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, [[Rom.9.32-33|Rom.9:32-33]], [[1Pe.2.8|1Pe.2:8]]" (LXX) ;
(b) **= προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block**: metaphorically, [[Rom.14.13, 20|Rom.14:13, 20]], [[1Co.8.9|1Co.8:9]] (Plut.).†
_SYN._: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.) (AS)

G4356.def:
**πρόσ-λημψις** (Rec. -ληψις, as in Att..), -εως, ἡ
(προσλαμβάνω),
1. an assumption (Plat.).
2. **a receiving **(cf. προσλαμβάνω): [[Rom.11.15|Rom.11:15]],†
(AS)

G4306.def:
**προ-μοέω**, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι,
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), [[Wis.6.7|Wis.6:7]], al. ;]
1. to foresee.
2. **to provide **(RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, [[Rom.12.17|Rom.12:17]] (-ούμενοι), [[2Co.8.21|2Co.8:21]] (-οῦμεν).
3. **to provide for **(before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), [[1Ti.5.8|1Ti.5:8]] (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).†
(AS)

G4332.def:
**προσεδρεύω**
(πρόσεδρος, sitting near), [in LXX: [[1Ma.11.40|1Ma.11:40]] * ;]
1. to sit near.
2. **to attend regularly**: with dative, [[1Co.9.13|1Co.9:13]], Rec. (see: παρεδρεύω).†
παρ-εδρεύω
[in LXX: [[Pro.1.21; 8.3|Pro.1:21 8:3]] * ;]
**to sit constantly beside, attend constantly **(cf. MM, xix): τ. θυσιαστηρίω, [[1Co.9.13|1Co.9:13]]†
(AS)

G4349.def:
**προσκοπή**, -ῆς, ή
(προσκόπτω), [in _Gr._ Ven.: [[Pro.16.18|Pro.16:18]] (כִּשָּׁלוֹן) * ;]
**an occasion of stumbling, offence**: [[2Co.6.3|2Co.6:3]]†
(AS)

G4322.def:
**προσ-αναπληρόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Wis.19.4|Wis.19:4]] * ;]
**to fill up by adding to, to supply fully**: [[2Co.9.12; 11.9|2Co.9:12 11:9]].†
(AS)

G4323.def:
**προσ-ανα-τίθημι **
**to lay on or offer besides**; mid.,
(a) **to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides**;
(b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, **to consult, communicate**: [[Gal.1.16; 2.6|Gal.1:16 2:6]] (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι)
(AS)

G4375.def:
**προσφιλής**, -ές
(φιλέω), [in LXX: [[Est.5.1|Est.5:1]], [[Sir.4.7; 20.13|Sir.4:7 20:13]] * ;]
(a) of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with);
(b) **of things, pleas­ing, agreeable **(EV, lovely): [[Php.4.8|Php.4:8]]†
(AS)

G4338.def:
**προσ-ηλόω -ῶ **
[in LXX: [[3Ma.4.9|3Ma.4:9]] * ;]
**to nail to**: with accusative and dative, figuratively, [[Col.2.14|Col.2:14]]†
(AS)

G4310.def: **to suffer first ** or **beforehand **, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: **to be ill-treated before **, ὑπό τινος (Thucydides):—;also, ἀγαθὸν πρ. (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4386.def:
before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time
**former, prior,** [[Eph.4.22|Eph. 4:22]] **before, former, prior,** [[Eph.4.22|Eph. 4:22]] **before, formerly,** [[Jhn.6.62|Jn. 6:62]]

G4359.def: **to owe besides ** or **still **, (Thucydides): _absolute_, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. **to be still owing, be still due **, (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred **which was still due ** from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4360.def:
**προσ-οχθίζω **
[in LXX: [[Lev.26.15|Lev.26:15]], al. (גָּעַל); [[Lev.18.25|Lev.18:25]], al. (קוֹא), [[Psa.95.10|Psa.95:10]], [[Ezk.36.31|Eze.36:31]] (קוּט), [[Sir.6.25|Sir.6:25]], al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;]
**to be angry with**: with dative, [[Heb.3.10|Heb.3:10]] (LXX), [[Heb.3.17|Heb.3:17]]†
(AS)

G4316.def:
**προσ-αγορεύω **
[in LXX: [[Deu.23.6|Deu.23:6]] (7) (דָּרַשׁ), ?[[Est.10.11|Est.10:11]] (יָדָה hith.), [[Wis.14.22|Wis.14:22]], [[1Ma.14.40|1Ma.14:40]], [[2Ma.1.36|2Ma.1:36]] [[2Mac.4.7|2Mac 4:7]] [[2Mac.10.9|2Mac 10:9]] [[2Mac.14.37|2Mac 14:37]] * ;]
**to address, greet, salute; hence, to call by name, address, style**: with dupl. accusative, pass., [[Heb.5.10|Heb.5:10]]†
(AS)

G4372.def:
**πρόσφατος**, -ον
(on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word and cf. -ως), [in LXX: [[Num.6.3|Num.6:3]] (לַח), [[Deu.32.17|Deu.32:17]], [[Ecc.1.9|Ecc.1:9]] (חָדָשׁ), [[Psa.81.9|Psa.81:9]] (זוּר), [[Sir.9.10|Sir.9:10]] * ;]
1. originally, freshly slain.
2. Generally (from Æsch. on), **new, fresh, recent**: ὁδός, [[Heb.10.20|Heb.10:20]] (see MM, _Exp._, xxi; Rutherford, _NPhr._, 471 f.).†
(AS)

G4380.def:
**προσωπολημπτέω** (Rec. -ληπτ-), -ῶ
(-λήμπτης, which see),
**to have respect of persons**: [[Jas.2.9|Jas.2:9]]†
(AS)

G4303.def:
**προ-μαρτύρομαι **
**to protest beforehand **(cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): [[1Pe.1.11|1Pe.1:11]] (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).†
(AS)
